blockers.description: CR-01 (Critical, code review): editing a session before its full detail loads (GET /api/sessions returns summary-only DTOs) wipes characters/locations/encounters/prepData/sessionLog server-side. Every edit surface (TopBar title, SessionLog notes, SessionPrep, Toolkit save) spreads the incomplete summary object into UPDATE_SESSION; the backend treats missing fields as null/empty; the new diff-merge from Plan 01-02 then deletes every existing child row. This is the exact bug class Phase 1 exists to fix, just relocated to a race window instead of the two originally-diagnosed bugs.
blockers.workaround: Reviewer proposed a concrete fix: track which sessions have loaded full detail (e.g. a detailLoadedIds ref/set) and gate dispatchWithPersist on it — refuse to persist session-shaped mutations until the full record has loaded. See 01-REVIEW.md CR-01 for the exact patch. Not yet applied.

decisions.decision: Client-side markdown rendering (react-markdown + remark-gfm + remark-breaks), not server-side Markdig
decisions.rationale: No Razor/server-rendering pipeline in Omphalos's minimal-API backend; avoids new backend dependency

decisions.decision: Cropper.js v2 web components integrated directly (no React wrapper library)
decisions.rationale: No maintained React wrapper exists for v2; react-cropper is still pinned to v1

decisions.decision: Dual original+cropped image storage per entity, served via dedicated cached binary endpoints
decisions.rationale: Ports quest-board's proven pattern; enables re-crop without re-upload, GIF fallback, and instant page loads

decisions.decision: PERSIST-03 (collection diff-merge) and PERSIST-04 (save-failure toast) added as new requirements during Phase 1 discuss-phase
decisions.rationale: User chose to fix the adjacent delete/reinsert anti-pattern and add save-failure UX while already touching the same code path

decisions.decision: Fix PERSIST-02 (partial-payload wipe) at the frontend call sites (full session spread), not via backend merge logic
decisions.rationale: Matches the existing safe dirtySessionRef pattern; smaller, more consistent fix

decisions.decision: First-ever test project: xUnit v3 (not legacy xunit v2) + Testcontainers.PostgreSql for integration tests, wired into CI
decisions.rationale: xUnit v2 is deprecated on nuget.org; Testcontainers gives 1:1 fidelity with production Postgres/JSONB, unlike EF InMemory or unconfirmed SQLite jsonb support

decisions.decision: Walking Skeleton mode overridden to false for Phase 1 despite the tool's default heuristic (MVP mode + phase 01 + zero summaries)
decisions.rationale: Omphalos is an existing, fully working, deployed brownfield app — not a from-scratch new project; forcing a minimal-skeleton framing would work against the thorough fix CONTEXT.md decided on
